faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know to get started.
faq.whereStoredAnswer: All recordings are stored locally on your computer. In Instant mode, they're also uploaded to Cap's cloud for easy sharing. You can manage storage in Settings.
faq.canChangeShortcuts: Can I change my shortcuts later?
faq.canChangeShortcutsAnswer: Head to Settings → Shortcuts at any time to customize all your keyboard shortcuts.
faq.howSharingWorksAnswer: In Instant mode, you get a shareable link automatically when you stop recording. In Studio mode, export your edited video and share via Cap's cloud or save locally.
faq.whatsTheDifference: What's the difference between Instant and Studio?
faq.whatsTheDifferenceAnswer: Instant mode uploads as you record — stop recording and you'll have a shareable link immediately. Studio mode records locally in full quality, letting you edit with backgrounds, effects, and more before sharing.
faq.isFreeAnswer: Cap is free for personal use. For teams and commercial use, check out our pricing plans.
